capabilities: Render taskwarrior reports as HTML tables in the reading view
Embed task counts using task-count code blocks
Run custom taskwarrior commands and filter expressions per code block
Add refresh action buttons to task tables
extras: The README includes a developer guide (release process, ESLint) alongside user documentation.
problem: Obsidian has no way to display tasks managed by an external taskwarrior installation inside notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin requires a functional, externally installed taskwarrior installation.

summary: Taskwarrior integration that renders task reports as HTML tables, ASCII tables, and counts in the reading view via code blocks.
